new_sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement' AND b.spent = (SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Advertisement') ORDER BY e.event_name

SELECT League.name, COUNT(Match.league_id) AS matches FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id GROUP BY League.id, League.name HAVING COUNT(Match.league_id) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(league_id) AS cnt FROM Match GROUP BY league_id)) ORDER BY League.name ASC

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', E.[Examination Date]) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age, E.Diagnosis FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID JOIN Examination AS E ON E.ID = L.ID WHERE L.HGB IS NOT NULL ORDER BY L.HGB DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 592 AND r.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname FROM results AS r INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 872 AND r.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%' AND p.birthday = (SELECT MIN(p2.birthday) FROM Player AS p2 JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id WHERE pa2.overall_rating = 77 AND pa2.date LIKE '2016-06-23%')

SELECT (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER)) AS age, forename || ' ' || surname AS name FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.name, r.year FROM lapTimes AS lt JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher' AND lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(lt2.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes AS lt2 JOIN drivers AS d2 ON lt2.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE d2.forename = 'Michael' AND d2.surname = 'Schumacher') ORDER BY r.year, r.name

WITH avg_finishing AS (SELECT P.player_name, P.player_api_id, AVG(PA.finishing) AS avg_finishing FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player) AND (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name) SELECT player_name FROM avg_finishing WHERE avg_finishing = (SELECT MAX(avg_finishing) FROM avg_finishing);

SELECT r.name, res.points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year = (SELECT MIN(r2.year) FROM results res2 JOIN races r2 ON res2.raceId = r2.raceId JOIN drivers d2 ON res2.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE d2.forename = 'Lewis' AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton') ORDER BY r.round

SELECT DISTINCT T2.url FROM constructorResults AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId WHERE T1.raceId = 9 AND T1.points = (SELECT MAX(points) FROM constructorResults WHERE raceId = 9)

SELECT drivers.forename || ' ' || drivers.surname FROM qualifying INNER JOIN races ON races.raceId = qualifying.raceId INNER JOIN circuits ON circuits.circuitId = races.circuitId INNER JOIN drivers ON drivers.driverId = qualifying.driverId WHERE circuits.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND races.year = 2008 AND qualifying.q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY qualifying.q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.superhero_name FROM hero_attribute AS ha INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id INNER JOIN superhero AS s ON ha.hero_id = s.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN drivers AS d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality ORDER BY SUM(ds.wins) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.publisher_name FROM hero_attribute AS HA INNER JOIN attribute AS A ON HA.attribute_id = A.id INNER JOIN superhero AS S ON HA.hero_id = S.id INNER JOIN publisher AS P ON S.publisher_id = P.id WHERE A.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND HA.attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(HA2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute AS HA2 INNER JOIN attribute AS A2 ON HA2.attribute_id = A2.id WHERE A2.attribute_name = 'Speed') ORDER BY P.publisher_name

SELECT DISTINCT T1.constructorRef, T1.url FROM constructors AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T3.year = 2009 AND T3.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' ORDER BY T2.time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM badges b JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer' AND b.Date = (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Autobiographer')
SELECT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'h' GROUP BY T2.label ORDER BY COUNT(T2.label) DESC
SELECT b.bond_type, m.label FROM bond AS b INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_type) DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT fd.name FROM cards AS c JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE fd.language = 'French' AND c.types = 'Creature' AND c.layout = 'normal' AND c.borderColor = 'black' AND c.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson' ORDER BY fd.name

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap FROM client AS c INNER JOIN disp AS di ON c.client_id = di.client_id INNER JOIN account AS a ON di.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = (SELECT birth_date FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' ORDER BY birth_date ASC LIMIT 1) AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT a.account_id FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993' AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(l2.amount) FROM loan AS l2 JOIN account AS a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id WHERE l2.duration > 12 AND STRFTIME('%Y', a2.date) = '1993') ORDER BY a.account_id
SELECT dp.account_id FROM client c JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, di.A11 ASC
